user: TICKET # In Prestashop 9.1 The custom features are listed in the default features list. Hi Custom features are listed in the default features list. If a custom value is created on a product page, it will appear in the default values ​​list. The problem is that it's not clear which are the default and which are the custom ones, and they're also displayed in the wrong place. ## Attendu Custom values ​​should not be displayed in the default values ​​list. Use the same behavior as PrestaShop 8. ## Étapes 1. Go to a product and add a custom value to a feature 2.
